source: select lead_source,count(case when stage='won' then 1 end), count(case when stage='lost' then 1 end), 1.0*count(case when stage='won' then 1 end)/nullif(count(case when stage in ('won','lost') then 1 end),0) from dash_demo.crm_opportunities group by 1
select stage,count(*),sum(amount) from dash_demo.crm_opportunities where stage not in ('won','lost') group by 1
select date_trunc('year',closed_date),count(case when stage='won' then 1 end),sum(case when stage='won' then amount end) from dash_demo.crm_opportunities group by 1

select date_trunc('year',closed_date),count(case when stage='won' then 1 end),sum(case when stage='won' then amount end),1.0*count(case when stage='won' then 1 end)/nullif(count(case when stage in ('won','lost') then 1 end),0) from dash_demo.crm_opportunities group by 1
